    JOIN assembly_contains ac ON cb.child_component_id = ac.parent_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')

-- Recursive traversal: find all parent assemblies that contain the target component

  SELECT 
    cb.parent_component_id AS assembly_id,

  FROM component_bom cb

  -- Recurse up: parents of assemblies that contain the target
  SELECT

    cb.qty
  FROM component_bom cb
  JOIN bom_paths bp ON cb.child_component_id = bp.assembly_id
  WHERE cb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find the component_id for CRO-650-WAL-01793

assembly_hierarchy AS (

  SELECT cb.parent_component_id AS assembly_id, cb.child_component_id, cb.qty
  FROM component_bom cb
  WHERE cb.child_component_id = (SELECT component_id FROM target_component)

    AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Recursive: find parents of assemblies
  SELECT cb.parent_component_id, cb.child_component_id, cb.qty
  FROM component_bom cb
  INNER JOIN assembly_hierarchy ah ON cb.child_component_id = ah.assembly_id
  WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
    AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- All assembly components that contain the target (including the target itself if it's used directly)
all_containing_assemblies AS (
  SELECT assembly_id AS component_id FROM assembly_hierarchy
  UNION
  SELECT component_id FROM target_component
),
-- Find company models that use any of these components directly in model_bom
models_with_component AS (

  FROM model_bom mb
  WHERE mb.component_id IN (SELECT component_id FROM all_containing_assemblies)
    AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE current_component_bom AS (
    SELECT parent_component_id, child_component_id, qty
    FROM component_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
current_model_bom AS (
    SELECT model_id, component_id, qty
    FROM model_bom
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Find the component_id for LEG-345-WAL-02603
target_component AS (
    SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'LEG-345-WAL-02603'
),
-- Recursive CTE: find all components that contain LEG-345-WAL-02603 at any level
-- Starting from assemblies that directly contain the target
assemblies_with_target AS (
    -- Direct containment: parent contains target as child
    SELECT ccb.parent_component_id AS assembly_id, ccb.qty
    FROM current_component_bom ccb
    JOIN target_component tc ON ccb.child_component_id = tc.component_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: parent contains an assembly that (transitively) contains target
    SELECT ccb.parent_component_id AS assembly_id, ccb.qty * awt.qty
    FROM current_component_bom ccb
    JOIN assemblies_with_target awt ON ccb.child_component_id = awt.assembly_id
),
-- All component IDs that contain the target (including the target itself if we want, but we need assemblies)
all_containing_assemblies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT assembly_id AS component_id FROM assemblies_with_target
),
-- Find all models that directly or indirectly use the target component
-- Direct: model BOM points to target component
-- Indirect: model BOM points to an assembly that contains target
models_with_target AS (
    -- Direct

),

-- Expand bundles: for each order line, get the item SKUs (or the SKU itself if not a bundle)
-- A bundle SKU has is_bundle=true and entries in bundle_item
-- A non-bundle SKU maps directly to models
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs: keep as-is
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.line_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.sku_id AS original_sku_id,
        ol.sku_id AS item_sku_id,
        1 AS bundle_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: explode to item SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.line_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.sku_id AS original_sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.qty AS bundle_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON ol.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ss.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
),

-- Map SKUs to models
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.*,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Now explode through model BOM to get components
model_components AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.*,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS bom_qty
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE sm.order_date >= mb.valid_from 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)

component_hierarchy AS (
    -- Base: components from model BOM
    SELECT 
        mc.order_id,
        mc.line_no,
        mc.line_qty,
        mc.bundle_qty,
        mc.model_qty,
        mc.bom_qty,
        mc.component_id,
        mc.order_date,
        mc.line_qty * mc.bundle_qty * mc.model_qty * mc.bom_qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_components mc

        ch.line_no,
        ch.line_qty,

        ch.model_qty,
